edge_cases: single 32x32 crouton tile; activation int8 in high byte of crouton slot (low bytes dead)
weight 4-deep packed; different load limit than activation in the same packet
output NARROWED to real int8 (not the raw uint16 12-bit field the sibling matmul tasks expose)
input ranges (A 0..3 uint8, B -1..1 int8) chosen so |r|<=127: no int8 saturation, narrow is exact
signed weights / negative accumulators (sign-extended from bit 11 before narrowing)
crouton pack/unpack staged via cacheable buffers + bulk vector copy
name: i8_matmul_hmx_requant
